observations.body: Comfort is announced, a wilderness voice commands preparation, and the LORD comes with power while tending his flock.
observations.label: A voice prepares the LORD’s way: action

observations.body: The herald is told to speak without fear and announce God’s arrival.

payload.tension: The prophetic speaker, the Gospel herald, and the arriving figure must not be collapsed into one unnamed role.
